cd /testbed && python -c "
from django.contrib.admin.views.autocomplete import AutocompleteJsonView

class CustomAutocompleteJsonView(AutocompleteJsonView):
    def serialize_result(self, obj, to_field_name):
        return super().serialize_result(obj, to_field_name) | {'notes': 'extra'}

print('Subclassing works, has serialize_result method:', hasattr(AutocompleteJsonView, 'serialize_result'))
